info.name: Carlos Yajie Fetizanan
info.bio: Intern at the Center for Artificial Intelligence and Smart Technologies at Batangas State University, majoring in IT with a focus on Business Analytics. Driven by a passion for unveiling hidden insights within expansive datasets and crafting exceptional digital experiences.

knowledge_base.content: Carlos Yajie Fetizanan is an IT Major in Business Analytics and an Intern at the Center for Artificial Intelligence and Smart Technologies at Batangas State University.
Carlos is currently a BSIT Undergraduate at Batangas State University Lipa.

Carlos holds several professional certifications: Google UX Design Professional Certificate, AWS Cloud Quest: Cloud Practitioner, Google Cybersecurity Professional Certificate, and Google AI Essentials. He also has AI & Python Certificates from DataCamp.
Carlos has high proficiency in creative tools: Figma (100%), Adobe XD (90%), Adobe Photoshop (85%), Adobe Premiere (70%), and Adobe Illustrator (60%).

Carlos offers a wide range of services including UI/UX Design (crafting intuitive interfaces), Video Editing (engaging visual stories), Graphic Design (brand identity), Web Development (responsive sites), Data Science, and Machine Learning.
Notable projects include: Event Management System, Baranggay Collection system, Coffee Farm Classification using CNN models, and Apex Insight.
Carlos has expertise in Machine Learning, having worked on 'Hands-On Large Language Models' and various other models hosted on his GitHub.
Web development projects include: Formula 1 2026, Formula 1, and Landing Page Razberie.
You can reach Carlos via email at cyfetizanan@gmail.com or by phone at +63 929 307 085.
Carlos is a multi-talented tech professional combining Machine Learning, Web Development, and UI/UX Design to solve complex problems and create beautiful digital experiences.
